commitResults.messageTitle: Add MishMash logging and organize code by responsibility
commitResults.messageBody:
Record application lifecycle, command execution and cancellation, and parser
diagnostics with Java's built-in logging. Rotate log files and release handlers
on shutdown so diagnostics stay separate from normal console interaction.

Replace the placeholder seedu.duke namespace with seedu.mishmash packages for
commands, parsing, models, generation, display, and exceptions. Move tests to
matching packages and share fixtures through test utilities while preserving
the integrated recipe listing, deletion, and meal-plan generation behavior.

Update the application entry point and produce MishMash.jar. Refresh setup
instructions and documentation branding, and include the existing User Guide
draft-note cleanup. Leave the Developer Guide unchanged.

Validated with Java 25: 558 tests passed, Checkstyle passed, and the packaged
application passed command and logging checks. Rebuilt the Shadow JAR with its
official filename.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align MishMash packages and helpers with Java conventions
commitResults.messageBody:
Move production code, tests, logger names, and the application entry point to
the project-root mishmash namespace. Keep the latest team grocery generation
and viewing integration intact and update README source paths.

Document nontrivial private helpers, use block Javadocs for classes and methods,
normalize import ordering, clarify the saved logging-state boolean, and name
logging limits and the recipe-combination divisor.

Split command parsing, candidate enumeration and sampling, recipe validation,
and meal-plan formatting into focused steps. Share recipe formatting through
RecipeViewer so addition confirmations and detailed listings cannot drift.
Preserve command feedback, validation errors, generation order, and long totals.

Enforce import ordering and missing documentation for nontrivial methods with
Checkstyle. Leave the User Guide and Developer Guide unchanged.

Verified with Java 25: build passed, all 572 test invocations passed, and both
Checkstyle checks passed. MishMash.jar passed recipe, plan, grocery, confirmation,
error-recovery, and logging smoke checks with the new entry point.

annotation boundaries and exact preservation of existing file contents

commitResults.messageTitle: Add delete-recipe command with confirmation
commitResults.messageBody: Users can remove a recipe by its 1-based index. The CLI names the recipe and asks y/n first, since later indices shift after a delete. Errors for a missing index are reported before asking. Parser now dispatches on the command word and attaches that command's usage to its errors, replacing the add-recipe usage that was always printed.
